name: Just-In-Time Activation Ready
description: Sent to the identity whose Just-In-Time activation has been successfully initiated. Notifies them that their activation window is now active.
subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} is now ready
body:
Just-In-Time Activation Ready

Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window you initiated for ${entitlementName} is now active for ${activationDuration}.

Activation details

  • Entitlement: ${entitlementName}
  • Active for: ${activationDuration}
#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here to see your options for extending or deactivating this entitlement early.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
